extraction.summary_en: AGE of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES held 2017-01-19 authorized (subject to suspensive conditions: bank financing and absence of creditor opposition) a capital decrease of up to €150,861 (368,102 → 217,241) via buyback and cancellation of 150,861 shares (nominal €1) held by minority shareholders, at €2.72/share. The decrease was not yet completed as of this filing; it merely authorizes the President to carry it out within 30 days.

evidence.quote_fr: DE L'ASSEMBLEE GENERALE MIXTE DU 19 JANVIER 2017

events.date_basis: The AGE of 19 January 2017 authorized the reduction subject to suspensive conditions not shown as satisfied in this document; no realisation date is given.
events.mechanism: rachat et annulation d'actions détenues par les associés minoritaires (art. L.225-207 C.com), prix de rachat 2,72 euros/action, décision soumise à conditions suspensives (financement bancaire, absence d'opposition des créanciers)

evidence.quote_fr: autorise la réduction du capital social pour un montant maximum de 150 861 euros, pour le ramener de 368 102 euros à 217 241 euros, par voie de rachat d'actions détenues par les associés minoritaires, en vue de leur annulation, selon les modalités fixées par l'article L. 225-207 du Code de commerce. Cette opération sera réalisée par le rachat de 150 861 actions de 1 euro de nominal chacune, au prix de 2,72 euros par action.

events.gloss_en: AGE authorizes a capital decrease of up to €150,861 (368,102→217,241) via buyback/cancellation of up to 150,861 shares from minority shareholders at €2.72/share, subject to suspensive conditions.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Capital stated in the AGE resolution prior to the authorized reduction.

evidence.quote_fr: autorise la réduction du capital social pour un montant maximum de 150 861 euros, pour le ramener de 368 102 euros à 217 241 euros

issues: The reduction is conditional on bank financing and absence of creditor opposition; this filing does not show the realisation, only the authorization, so the actual capital-after figure (217,241) may not have been achieved if fewer than 150,861 shares were bought back.
No shareholder names or share allocations are given in this filing, so no snapshot of the cap table by holder could be built.
The letterhead states capital of 368,102 euros (pre-reduction), consistent with the resolution text; not used as an independent snapshot per instructions but corroborates the figure.
